name: Jausenstation Hochschwendt
beschreibung: Jausenstation Hochschwendt is delightfully perched on a sunny hillside above Ellmau at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser massif. This traditional mountain tavern is a beloved destination for hikers, families, and ski tourers. Visitors enjoy panoramic vistas across the Ellmau valley and surrounding alpine peaks from the sun-drenched outdoor terrace. The cozy parlor serves traditional Tyrolean comfort food, hearty cold cuts platters with local cheeses and bacon, and freshly baked homemade cakes. Set amidst the Wilder Kaiser trail network, it provides an idyllic stop for alpine refreshments.
kurzbeschreibung: Popular alpine snack station perched above Ellmau am Wilden Kaiser offering panoramic views and Tyrolean cooking.
